@graph.description:
We want to recreate the original Drop-seq cell atlas of the mouse retina from Macosko et al. 2015 Cell, GEO accession GSE63473. The data is 49,300 STAMPs collected from postnatal-day-14 mouse retinas across 7 experimental batches over 4 days. Sequencing on NextSeq 500. Drop-seq cell barcode is 12 bp on read 1, UMI is 8 bp, cDNA on read 2. Reference is mm10.

Use Drop-seq tools (McCarroll lab) to convert FASTQ to a digital gene expression (DGE) matrix; do not use Cell Ranger.

The clustering follows the paper's protocol exactly. Take the 13,155 cells with more than 900 genes detected as the training set and run PCA in Seurat. Identify the 32 statistically significant PCs by permutation test. Run t-SNE on those 32 PCs. Project the remaining 36,145 cells onto the t-SNE map based on their PC-subspace representation. Apply density clustering (Ester et al. 1996, DBSCAN-style) on the resulting t-SNE point cloud. The expected output is 39 transcriptionally distinct clusters spanning the 5 neuronal retinal classes (photoreceptor = rods+cones, bipolar, horizontal, retinal ganglion, amacrine) plus non-neuronal populations (Mueller glia, microglia, astrocyte, endothelial, pericyte). Cluster sizes range from ~50 to ~29,400.

Within the amacrine compartment, focus on the 21 amacrine clusters and classify them by neurotransmitter markers: 12 should be GABAergic (Gad1/Gad2+), 5 glycinergic (Slc6a9+), 1 excitatory (Slc17a8+), and 3 nGnG (clusters 4, 20, 21). Cluster 16 should mark as A-II amacrines (high Gjd2) and cluster 3 as SACs (high Chat). Recreate the cluster 7 vs cluster 6 DE finding (16 genes at >2.8-fold, p<1e-9) and the cluster 20 vs cluster 21 DE finding (12 genes at >2.8-fold, p<1e-9).

Run McDavid et al. 2013 likelihood-ratio test for differential expression. Build a dendrogram from Euclidean distance + complete linkage on cluster centroids.

Also recreate the species-mixing experiments (HEK+3T3 across cell concentrations 12.5/25/50/100 cells/uL) and reproduce the doublet rates (0.36%/1.4%/4.6%/11.3%), single-cell purity (98.8% down to 90.4%), and the cell-cycle reconstruction (544 human + 668 mouse cell-cycle genes at FDR 5%, 200 orthologous pairs).

No mechanistic claims -- descriptive cell atlas only.

ENA, PRIDE, ClinVar, gnomAD, GTEx) or SME-supplied paths. Emits a cohort manifest,
per-accession provenance summary, and an index pointing at the materialized
artifacts. Downstream atoms consume the manifest, not the raw bytes directly.

per-accession provenance summary, and an index pointing at the materialized
artifacts. Downstream atoms consume the manifest, not the raw bytes directly.

Run sequencing QC (FastQC, MultiQC) on raw FASTQ inputs. Emits a per-sample metric
table and aggregated report; downstream `sequence_trimming` reads the trim-needed
flag.

Validate outputs of: Run sequencing QC (FastQC, MultiQC) on raw FASTQ inputs. Emits a per-sample metric

Retrieve a context-scoped METHOD-LANDSCAPE for this analysis: for each
runtime method-choice axis in the workflow, gather candidate methods and
PMID/DOI/URL-anchored evidence, conditioned on the specific data
(organism, protocol, sample count, missingness from the upstream QC +
sample-manifest) and the analysis goal/modality. Honors
config/downstream-policy/source-discovery-policy.json. Emit a
method_landscape.csv where every row is locator-anchored with a
substring-verified evidence_quote. No synthesis; no ranking (the
discover_* atoms rank deterministically from this table).
Discover method for sequence_trimming (options: trimmomatic, cutadapt, fastp, trim_galore). Surface set_intake_method.
Discover method for quantification (options: salmon, kallisto, featurecounts, htseq, rsem). Surface set_intake_method.
Discover method for pathway_enrichment (options: fgsea, clusterprofiler, gsea, enrichr). Surface set_intake_method.
Discover method for normalisation (options: deseq2_vst, edger_tmm, scran, seurat_lognormalize, sctransform). Surface set_intake_method.
Discover method for dimensionality_reduction (options: pca, umap, tsne, phate). Surface set_intake_method.
Discover method for differential_expression (options: deseq2, edger, limma_voom, mast, wilcoxon). Surface set_intake_method.
Discover method for clustering (options: leiden, louvain, kmeans, hierarchical, seurat). Surface set_intake_method.
Discover method for cell_type_annotation (options: celltypist, singler, azimuth, sctype, marker_panel). Surface set_intake_method.
Discover method for batch_correction (options: harmony, scvi, bbknn, mnn_correct, combat, seurat_cca). Surface set_intake_method.
Discover method for alignment (options: star, hisat2, bwa_mem2, bwa_mem, minimap2, bowtie2). Surface set_intake_method.

EDAM operation:3218 conflates raw-read QC with count-matrix QC.
